title: 'get your bearings' never names the road onward once you're at a hold's outer edge — from the Meres there was no bearing or quest text pointing toward Wardmoor (the actual connector to Coldpass); it only turned up by retracing Barrowmere's old 'west to Wardmoor' exit remembered from an earlier, unrelated visit.
